title: More You Take
prompt: The more you take, the more you leave behind.
hints: Think literally. With every action you take one, something is also created.
Consider walking. Each time you take a step, what do you leave behind you?
They only exist once you've moved past.
solution_lede: Every step you *take* leaves a *footstep* behind you. The more steps you take moving forward, the more footsteps accumulate in your wake. You are both creating and leaving them simultaneously — and you can never pick them back up.

solution_steps.body: Taking = stepping forward. Leaving behind = the impression each foot makes on the ground.
Each step taken creates one footstep left behind. More steps = more footsteps.
